text:
Type: velvet eyelet curtains, pair
Use: dressing a window, dimming light, adding privacy; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, glam, classic
Materials: soft cotton velvet with a subtle sheen, metal eyelet heading
Colors: light turquoise, soft aqua blue
Shape: two full-length straight panels with deep, even folds from an eyelet top, plain solid fabric, heavy and fluid drape
Feel: soft, rich, calm, luxurious
Goes with: white or grey walls, brass or chrome accents, velvet cushions, light wood; contemporary, glam or classic living rooms

product.name: SANELA
product.description: The thick curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
